cves.title: Command injection in GlobalProtect gateway
cves.summary: Unauthenticated OS command injection in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS lets an attacker run arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

cves.title: Citrix Bleed: session token disclosure
cves.summary: Sensitive information disclosure in NetScaler ADC and Gateway leaks session tokens, letting attackers hijack authenticated sessions and bypass MFA.

cves.title: Unauthenticated RCE in NetScaler
cves.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution when the appliance is configured as a gateway or AAA virtual server.

cves.title: Command injection in web components
cves.summary: Authenticated administrators can send crafted requests to execute commands. Chained with CVE-2023-46805 for unauthenticated RCE.

cves.title: Authentication bypass in web component
cves.summary: Authentication bypass allowing access to restricted resources by skipping control checks.

cves.title: Administrative interface authentication bypass
cves.summary: Authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel lets an unauthenticated attacker perform operations on the administrative interface via crafted HTTP requests.

cves.title: Heap overflow in SSL-VPN
cves.summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted requests.

cves.title: Privilege escalation in IOS XE web UI
cves.summary: Unauthenticated remote attacker can create an account with privilege level 15 on devices exposing the web UI.

cves.title: ProxyLogon SSRF
cves.summary: Server-side request forgery in Exchange Server, chained with CVE-2021-27065 for pre-auth remote code execution.

cves.title: ProxyNotShell SSRF
cves.summary: Server-side request forgery in Exchange Server, chained with CVE-2022-41082 to reach PowerShell remoting and execute code.

cves.title: ProxyNotShell remote code execution
cves.summary: Remote code execution in Exchange Server when PowerShell is reachable by an authenticated attacker.

cves.title: Outlook elevation of privilege via NTLM leak
cves.summary: A crafted calendar item or message triggers an NTLM authentication attempt to an attacker-controlled host with no user interaction.

cves.title: PrintNightmare
cves.summary: Remote code execution in the Windows Print Spooler service, exploitable for privilege escalation on domain controllers.

cves.title: SQL injection in MOVEit Transfer
cves.summary: SQL injection in the web application allows an unauthenticated attacker to access the database and deploy a web shell. Used in mass data-theft campaigns.

cves.title: Broken access control creates admin accounts
cves.summary: Unauthenticated attackers can create Confluence administrator accounts on internet-facing instances.

cves.title: Authentication bypass in TeamCity
cves.summary: Authentication bypass lets an attacker gain administrative control of the CI/CD server, putting build pipelines and secrets at risk.

cves.title: Authentication bypass in ScreenConnect
cves.summary: Authentication bypass using an alternate path allows direct access to confidential information or critical systems.

cves.title: Remote command injection via TAR file handling
cves.summary: Improper input validation of TAR attachment filenames allows remote command execution on the appliance.

cves.title: Log4Shell
cves.summary: JNDI lookup in log messages allows remote code execution in countless Java enterprise applications and appliances.

cves.title: Spring4Shell
cves.summary: Data binding on JDK 9+ lets a remote attacker obtain a class loader and achieve code execution on Spring MVC and WebFlux apps.

cves.title: regreSSHion race condition
cves.summary: Signal handler race condition in sshd allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

cves.title: Backdoor in xz/liblzma
cves.summary: Malicious code inserted into upstream xz release tarballs modifies liblzma behaviour and can enable unauthorized sshd access.
